upper_replay.scope: Fresh physical H8 polynomial Rayleigh quotient only. No supplied moment table, complement-gap proof, or ground-spin theorem is used.

chains.scope: Physical correlated upper state: apply I-eta*h at every cut between consecutive H8 blocks, then append an unfiltered fixed-particle remainder if present.
